column1: # The vendor executables of the OMG interoperability suites, as the suites release them.
# provision.sh downloads each from the suite's GitHub release, checks the sha256
# GitHub publishes for the asset and unpacks it under <dest>/vendors/<suite>/: in the
# ci-omg image of GitLab (ci/Dockerfile.omg, /opt/omg) and in the interop workflow of
# GitHub. A change here rebuilds the ci-omg image.
